leave_sick_days_001.evidence: Those employed for one hundred eighty-four (184) days—ten (10) days, based on the formula (184 x 6.50 x .055) = 65.52 hours per year, accumulating up to 1300 work hours.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: When an employee becomes ill, is injured, or is required to care for a sick immediate family member, sick leave begins at the time of inability to continue to work

leave_personal_days_004.evidence: One (1) day of leave with pay each year is granted to an employee for personal matters which require the employee’s absence during school hours.

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Submit special leave slip to supervisor at least 3 days prior; not subject to principal approval except in emergencies; no reason required.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: Except in emergency situations, this leave is not subject to principal approval, however the employee must submit a special leave slip to their supervisor at least three (3) days prior to the date the leave will be taken.
